test_relax_job: test the relax_job function to perform geometry optimization on molecular structures using a FAIRChem calculator
test_single_point_job: test the single_point_job function to compute energy and forces for a molecular structure
test_conformers: test the conformers function to run geometry optimization on multiple molecular conformers in parallel
test_ieea: test the ieea function to calculate unoptimized ionization energy and electron affinity for molecules
test_ligand_strain: test the ligand_strain function to compute ligand strain energy from bioactive and gas-phase conformers
